original_regressions_reproduced: A weak browser suite could pass without witnessing the explicitly requested reload behavior.
Large source assets and more than 2048 files exhausted the old manifest limits.
A valid page loading 300 local assets was incorrectly marked dependency-incomplete.
An unused node_modules directory blocked otherwise measured reload evidence.
An early source file changed while a later asset streamed, yet the old final directory-only check kept its old digest marked complete.

guards: Fresh host observations are bound to original instructions, source content, checker implementation and actual saved suite.
Imported fabricated reports, substitutions and permit replays cannot mint normal host execution receipts.
Full application source with explicitly excluded unused runtime roots qualifies only alongside complete actual local browser dependency observations.
Loaded excluded runtime assets, unavailable inputs, changed files and exhausted limits remain unverified.
Creation and deletion require distinct measured effects; returning to an initial empty result without a persisted baseline is insufficient.
Final file identity checks retain existing content hashes without rereading the content.

large_import_measurement.scope: Earlier streaming candidate, before the final included-file identity pass; not final-release end-to-end timing.

limits: Narrow supported reload observations do not prove every natural-language requirement or general program correctness.
Streaming manifests are bounded real disk I/O, not atomic filesystem snapshots; cold or slow scans can remain limited.
The optional observed-dependency acceleration prototype is not included or activated.
Private native field-value authoring and repair-budget migration experiments are not included.
Receipts are not model training approval or protection against deliberate same-user database/process tampering.
Scoped tests do not establish a new full fresh-PC installation or microphone/music-generation qualification.
